What's-the-rumpus liver pâté toasts.make_ahead: Pâté up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Trim the livers and sear in butter for 2 minutes a side until still pink.
Add the shallots and thyme, then the apple juice and vinegar, and let it bubble off.
Blitz with the soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish.
Pour over the clarified butter and chill for 4 hours.
Toast the rye and serve with the pâté.

Leo's Danny Boy Irish stew.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the lamb in batches in oil.
Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Pour over the stock and molasses, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours until tender.
Finish with parsley.

Whisky bread pudding.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake to serve

steps.text: Soak the raisins in the orange juice and vanilla for 30 minutes.
Butter the brioche and layer in a dish with the raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream and sugar and pour over.
Rest for 30 minutes.
Bake at 170C until puffed and golden.

Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy.n: Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Boil the water and steep the tea bags in it for 4 minutes, then lift them out.
Cut four lemon wheels and stud each with cloves.
Into four heatproof glasses put honey and the juice of the remaining lemons.
Top with the hot smoky tea and stir until the honey dissolves.
Float a studded wheel on top, add a cinnamon stick and serve hot.
Brown the shanks in the oil.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic.
Add the stock, grape juice, vinegar, tomatoes and rosemary, cover and braise at 160C.
Cook the polenta in salted water, stir in the butter.
Serve the shanks on top of the polenta.
Peel the pears, keeping the stalks.
Simmer the grape juice and lemon juice with the water, sugar, cinnamon and orange peel, add the pears and poach, turning.
Reduce the syrup.
Serve the pears with mascarpone and syrup.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and cool. This gives a dry, grippy finish.
Stir the grape juice with the tea, blood orange juice, vanilla and honey until the honey dissolves.
Add the sliced orange, diced apple and cinnamon stick.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each, and top with a splash of soda water.
Cut the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk some of the flour with the soda water to a thin batter.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C until crisp.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.
For each drink, measure 15ml blue curacao syrup, 30ml coconut water, 90ml pineapple juice, 30ml coconut cream and a drop of vanilla into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice until frothy.
Strain into tall glasses full of crushed ice and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

Rain-soaked ramen.make_ahead: Pork and eggs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Braise the pork belly in the soy, apple juice, sugar, rice vinegar and water, covered, on a low simmer.
Soft-boil the eggs, peel and marinate in some of the braising liquid.
Slice the pork. Heat the stock and season with a little soy.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls.
Top with pork, halved egg, nori and spring onion.

Deckard's Japanese whisky highball.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and stir in the honey and vanilla.
Chill the tea in the freezer until very cold.
Pack four tall glasses with ice, stir to chill, then pour off any water.
Add 60ml of the cold tea to each and stir.
Top slowly with very cold soda water down the spoon. Squeeze a strip of lemon peel over each.
Soak the gelatine in cold water.
Warm the water with the sugar, squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve.
Cool slightly, then gently stir in the sparkling grape juice.
Pour into coupes over raspberries.
Chill.
Make the syrup ahead by dissolving equal parts sugar and hot water, then cool.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.
Strain into tall glasses over fresh ice and top with soda water.

Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard.n: Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water and knead.
Rise in a covered bowl until doubled.
Shape into 8 pretzels.
Boil each briefly in the water with the bicarb, then drain and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake at 220C until deep brown.
Mix the mustard, apple juice and honey for the dip.

Firehouse lemon shandy.make_ahead: Lemon mix up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice, sugar and water until the sugar dissolves.
Chill 4 glasses in the freezer.
Pour alcohol-free lager into each glass and top with lemonade. Add a splash of the lemon mix.
Add a sprig of mint and a lemon wheel.
Brown the chicken in oil
Soften the mushrooms and leeks
Add the stock, lemon juice and cream and simmer until thick
Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry and brush with egg
Bake at 200C until golden

Séance night cherry Shiraz sangria.make_ahead: Make a jug ahead, add soda to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and cool.
Put the cherries, orange and cinnamon in a jug.
Add the grape juice, cherry juice, tea, vanilla and sugar and stir to dissolve.
Chill.
Add the soda water just before serving and stir.
Pour into heavy glasses over ice with some fruit in each.

Dinner for twelve braised short ribs.n: Dinner for twelve braised short ribs

steps.text: Season and brown the short ribs in batches.
Add the stock, grape juice, vinegar, garlic and thyme. Cover and braise at 150C until tender.
Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat.
Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and parmesan.
Spoon the ribs over the polenta.

Continental bourbon sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out, stir in the vanilla and chill until cold.
Juice the lemons. Shake 50ml of the tea with the lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, one drink at a time.
Add ice and shake again.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass and grate a little nutmeg over the foam.
Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Cook with the water and rice vinegar.
Boil the eggs for a soft yolk, cool and peel.
Serve the rice in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a halved egg.
Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, lift out and chill. It adds a dry, grassy edge.
Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of four tall glasses with lime, dip in the salt and fill with ice.
Juice the grapefruits and limes, keeping one grapefruit wedge per glass.
Pour the green tea, grapefruit juice, lime juice and agave syrup into each glass.
Top with soda water, stir and add a grapefruit wedge.
Brown the beef with the sliced onions and thyme.
Add the stock and Worcestershire and braise.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200C.
Cut thick chips and fry twice until golden.
Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.

Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour.n: Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour (alcohol-free)
Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill until cold.
Mix the honey with warm water for honey syrup and juice the lemons.
Shake 50ml of the smoky tea with the lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice, one drink at a time.
Shake again with ice and strain into a tumbler over ice.
Grate a little nutmeg over the foam.
Slice the garlic and chop the parsley.
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Toast the panko in oil until golden.
Heat the butter and oil, add the garlic and chilli flakes and cook briefly.
Add the prawns and cook until pink, then add the fish stock and bubble.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, lemon zest and juice and the parsley.
Top with the crumbs.

Gin French 75 with champagne.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Chill the flutes. Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice and strain into each flute.
Top slowly with the chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Add a long twist of lemon peel.
Cut the fish into strips. Whisk the flour, soda water and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.

Bonfire tequila and lime margaritas.make_ahead: Jug can be mixed ahead for the esky

steps.text: Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, lift out and cool over a few ice cubes.
Rub the tumbler rims with lime and dip in flaky salt. Fill with ice.
Shake the cold tea, lime juice, orange juice and agave with ice.
Strain over the ice and garnish with a lime wheel.

Jean-Claude's tarragon roast chicken.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and layer in a dish with the cream, garlic and salt.
Mash the butter with chopped tarragon and push under the chicken skin.
Roast the chicken at 220C, then at 180C, with the gratin on the lower shelf until tender and golden.
Rest the chicken.
Add the stock, lemon juice and Dijon to the tray, scrape and reduce by half.
Steam the beans and serve.

I will find you fresh lemon soda.n: I will find you fresh lemon soda

steps.text: Squeeze six of the lemons and cut the last into wheels.
Stir the vanilla into the sugar syrup.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add lemon juice and syrup to each.
Top with cold soda water, stir and add a lemon wheel.
Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, stock and lemon juice and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, cover and cook until they open.
Add the prawns and snapper and cook just until done. Serve with sourdough.
Brew the coffee and warm the glasses with a little of the hot water.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick but still pourable.
Tip out the water. For each glass stir sugar and a few drops of vanilla into hot coffee.
Pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Reduce the stock and balsamic with the pan juices for gravy.
Steep the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and cool.
Put a sugar cube in each of 4 coupes and soak with a teaspoon of the strong tea and a drop of vanilla.
Add 15ml apple juice to each.
Slowly top with the cold alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Twist lemon peel over and drop it in.

Coco Bongo bananas Foster.make_ahead: Make to serve, the sauce is best hot

steps.text: Melt the butter, sugar and cinnamon in a wide pan until bubbling.
Halve the bananas lengthways and cook, spooning the sauce over.
Pour in the orange juice and vanilla and let it bubble into a glossy sauce.
Spoon over bowls of ice cream and scatter with pecans.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add melon syrup, a splash of soda water and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with lemonade, stir and add an umbrella.

London pie and mash.make_ahead: Filling a day ahead, top and bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.
Add the stock, Worcestershire and water to cover and simmer until tender.
Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.

Aether blood orange and cranberry spritz.n: Aether blood orange and cranberry spritz (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Stir the sugar into the hot water with one rosemary sprig and steep, then lift out the sprig.
Shake the rosemary syrup, juices and lime juice hard with ice, in batches.
Strain into wine glasses full of ice and top with soda water.
Garnish with a blood orange wheel and a rosemary sprig.
Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C.
Season the steaks and sear in a hot pan on both sides.
Add most of the butter, the garlic and thyme and baste briefly. Rest the steaks.
Add the stock and balsamic to the pan and reduce by half.
Saute the beans in the remaining butter. Serve with the steaks and potatoes.
Drop raspberries into each flute and add a splash of grapefruit juice.
Slowly top with the chilled alcohol-free sparkling rosé.
Rub a small rosemary sprig between your hands and add one to each glass.
Brown the beef and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the stock, grape juice and balsamic.
Simmer gently until tender and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the beef.
Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, lift out and chill.
Rub the rims of the glasses with lime and dip in salt.
For each drink, measure 45ml green tea, 15ml blue curacao syrup, the juice of 1 lime and 5ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice for 10 seconds, then strain over fresh ice.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

Fruit cake from home with brandy butter.n: Fruit cake from home with brandy butter
Fruit cake from home with brandy butter.make_ahead: Orange butter up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Beat the soft butter with icing sugar until pale, then beat in the orange juice and vanilla a little at a time until fluffy.
Chill the orange butter for 20 minutes.
Wrap the fruit cake in foil.
Warm at 160C.
Cut into thick slices and serve with the orange butter and cheddar wedges.
Slice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk
Whisk the flour with the cold soda water and salt
Heat the oil to 185C
Drain the onions, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden
Drain and salt lightly

Leaky Cauldron stew.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots with the thyme.
Return the beef, add the stock and Worcestershire, cover and braise at 160C.
Serve with crusty bread and butter.
Whisk the flour with cold soda water to a light batter.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.
Dip the fish strips and fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, fish, crema and salsa.
Soften the fennel and garlic in the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes and fish stock.
Simmer to a rich broth.
Add the fish, prawns and mussels, cover and cook until the mussels open.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.
Cut the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.
Whisk the flour with the cold soda water.
Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C in batches until puffed and golden.
Salt and serve hot.
Slice the onions and brown the beef in oil.
Brown.
Add the onions, stock, Worcestershire and water to cover and simmer.
Thicken with the flour, spoon into a pie dish and top with pastry brushed with egg.
Bake at 200C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas.
Cook.

Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dip.n: Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dip

steps.text: Cut the dough into bite-size pieces.
Simmer the water with the bicarb and drop the pieces in briefly, in batches. Drain.
Lay on a lined tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock, Worcestershire and milk.
Add the cheddar, mustard and paprika and stir until smooth.
Cut the limes into wedges.
Gently muddle the mint, lime and sugar in each glass.
Add 30ml apple juice to each and fill with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir from the bottom.
Slice the orange and lime.
Pour the juices into a big bowl with ice and the sliced fruit.
Top with lemonade and ginger beer for a bit of bite.
Chill the flutes in the freezer.
Pour the cordial into each glass, tilt and top slowly with the alcohol-free sparkling wine so it does not foam over.
Drop a raspberry into each glass and serve straight away.
Gently muddle the mint leaves with the syrup and lime juice in a jug, without shredding the mint.
Add the apple juice and divide between glasses filled with crushed ice.
Top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig.
Boil the water with the hibiscus, ginger and sugar, then turn off and steep.
Strain and chill.
Stir in the pineapple juice and lime juice.
Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel.
Steep the tea bags, remove and stir in the sugar and vanilla until dissolved.
Cool, then chill.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add the tea and squeeze in a lemon wedge.
Slap a mint sprig between your hands and drop it in.

The Vesper gin and vodka martini.n: The Vesper gin and vodka martini (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Shake the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice hard with ice until very cold, in batches if needed.
Strain into deep chilled coupes and add a long strip of lemon peel to each.

Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic.n: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Mix the sugar and lemon myrtle on a plate. Run a lime around each glass rim and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice, add non-alcoholic gin and lime juice.
Top with tonic and add a lime wheel.

Argyle's limo bar old fashioned.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water for a demerara syrup.
Stir 240ml of the tea, the syrup, vanilla and a strip of orange zest with ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each.
Squeeze orange peel over each, rub the rim and drop it in.

Speakeasy lemonade.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water.
Cool the syrup.
Squeeze the lemons into a jug and add the syrup.
Add plenty of ice and top with soda water.
Pour into teacups and add a splash of non-alcoholic gin to the grown-ups' cups.

ingredients.item: sugar syrup (from caster sugar and water)

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out, add the vanilla and cool.
Make the sugar syrup by dissolving equal parts caster sugar and hot water, then cool.
Shake 45ml of the tea with the juices, sugar syrup and almond syrup over ice, one drink at a time.
Strain over crushed ice and top with mint.

Are you not entertained spiced honey win.n: Are you not entertained spiced honey wine (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Steep the tea bag in the boiling water for 5 minutes and lift out.
Pour the grape juice and tea into a pot with the honey, lemon juice, peppercorns, bay leaves, saffron and orange peel.
Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling.
Strain into cups and serve warm.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice, squeeze lime juice into each and top with ginger beer.
Float 45ml of the dark tea over the top so it clouds down through the glass.
Garnish with a lime wedge and crystallised ginger.
Chill 4 tall cups or glasses.
Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each, then pour in the alcohol-free lager, tilting the cup.
Top with the ginger beer, drop in a lime wedge and mint sprig and serve straight away.
Frost four glasses in the freezer.
Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool.
Squeeze 4 lemons and mix the juice with the syrup and soda water.
Half fill each glass with cold alcohol-free lager and top with the lemon mix and lemonade.
Add a lemon wheel and serve on the porch.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes and lift out.
Chill the tea, and the coupe glasses, in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml of the tea, the grape juice, balsamic and vanilla, then stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the glasses, drop in a cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

Magda's New Year's Eve champagne punch.n: Magda's New Year's Eve champagne punch (alcohol-free)

steps.text: In a large punch bowl, mix the vanilla, peach nectar, orange juice and the sliced peaches.
Chill 1 hour.
Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in the chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine and the soda water.
Stir once gently.
Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in each.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each.
Top each with a bottle of cold alcohol-free lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.
In each tall glass muddle mint leaves with lime wedges and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Fill with crushed ice and pour in 30ml apple juice.
Top with soda water and stir from the bottom with a long spoon. Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
Cut the pineapple into wedges for garnish.
Blend the pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice, syrup, vanilla and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into four tall glasses and garnish with a pineapple wedge, a cherry and a paper umbrella.
Stir the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice over ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into a chilled glass with a cocktail onion.
Touch the rim of the chilled glasses with a little honey and lime.
For each drink, stir the non-alcoholic gin with a splash of verjuice over ice and strain in.
Serve straight away.
Steep the hibiscus, ginger, cloves and orange peel in the boiling water for 30 minutes.
Strain, stir in the sugar and chill.
Serve over ice with a squeeze of lime in each glass.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out, add the vanilla and chill.
Juice the limes and scoop out the passionfruit pulp. Cut pineapple wedges for garnish.
Shake the cold tea, pineapple juice, passionfruit, lime juice and grenadine with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a pineapple wedge.

Maple syrup bourbon smash.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill.
Juice the lemons and slice the apple thinly.
Press the mint gently with the syrup and lemon juice in a shaker, one drink at a time.
Add 50ml of the tea and ice, shake hard, and strain into rocks glasses packed with crushed ice.
Garnish with a mint sprig and an apple slice.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Shake 180ml of the tea, the lemon juice and 40ml of the syrup with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain into four ice-filled highballs, top with lemonade and soda, stir once and add a lemon wheel.
Steep the jasmine tea and smoked tea bag in water just off the boil, then strain. The smoky tea stands in for the rye.
Chill the tea.
Stir the honey into a little hot water to loosen it.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and add cold tea, honey syrup and lemon juice to each.
Stir, top with soda water and add a strip of lemon peel.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add 30ml of the tea and some lime juice to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.
Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, lift out and chill in the freezer.
Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in salt.
Blend the cold tea, the juice of the remaining limes, orange juice, sugar syrup and ice until smooth and slushy.
Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. Serve immediately.
Warm the heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out.
Add brown sugar and a few drops of vanilla to each, pour in hot coffee and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Lightly whip the cream until just thickened but still pourable.
Pour slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Put four martini glasses in the freezer.
Stir the non-alcoholic gin, verjuice and brine over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into the frozen glasses and garnish each with three olives on a pick.
Peel strips of zest from the orange.
Simmer the apple juice with the honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, cloves and zest, then add the tea bag for 3 minutes and lift it out.
Turn the heat to low and add the ginger beer, warming through without boiling.
Ladle into mugs and add a cinnamon stick to each.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Blend the syrup with the lemon juice, cold water and ice until slushy.
Pour into cups, garnish with lemon wheels and serve with straws.
Juice three of the lemons, cut the last into wheels and mix the juice with the syrup, then chill.
Chill four pint glasses in the freezer.
Pour some lemon mix into each glass, add soda water, then top slowly with cold alcohol-free lager.
Stir once and add a lemon wheel.
Steep the tea bags in the just boiled water for 4 minutes and lift out.
Put honey and lemon juice in each of 4 mugs.
Top with the hot smoky tea and stir.
Drop in a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves.

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus sprigs to garnish

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill.
Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool.
For each drink, muddle lemon wedges with mint leaves and syrup in a shaker.
Add 50ml of the tea and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds.
Pour into a short glass, top with crushed ice and garnish with a mint sprig.

Rockies maple whisky sour.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill until cold.
Shake 240ml of the tea with the lemon juice, maple syrup and egg whites without ice for 15 seconds, two drinks at a time.
Add ice and shake again until very cold.
Strain over fresh ice into rocks glasses and grate a little nutmeg over the foam.
